name: vibeaudio
description: VibeAudio: procedural focus music for AI coding agents

plugins.name: vibeaudio
plugins.description: Procedural focus music while Claude Code works, with a chime when it finishes or needs you.

plugins.name: vibeaudio-mod
plugins.description: Control VibeAudio from inside Claude Code: /vibeaudio opens a pane (mute, genre, volume, music, speech, banners, the share card) and a band shows while you are muted. A mod: it runs inside Claude Code with your permissions. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287+ and the vibe CLI (npm i -g vibeaudio).
